Summary: Redesign App Entrypoint ("/") as World Selection Hub using Your Worlds 2026 Design
Description: Redesign the primary entrypoint ("/") of Mytherion so users land directly on an immersive, high-fantasy 'Your Worlds' selection hub based on the approved design in mytherion-frontend/design/mytherion_your-worlds_2026. Includes ambient floating shards, glass command search & sort bar, bento/interactive world cards, docked top bar, and Redux wiring to ProjectModal and /projects/[projectId].
